item.subject: science
item.stem:
Riya is helping her mother in the kitchen. She presses a ball of dough with her hands, and later she pushes a rolling pin that was lying still on the shelf, making it roll across the table.
Which statement about the effect of an applied force is correct?

options.A: A force only counts when it makes an object start moving from rest.
options.B: An applied force can change an object's shape as well as its state of motion.
options.C: A force changes the direction of an object first, and that change then produces the applied force.
options.D: An applied force can change the speed of an object but can never change its shape.
